phase_name: Build the Read-Only doc_id -> PDF Resolver

objectives.description: Create zotero-resolve-pdf.sh with doc-id/stdin input and storage-root derivation
Implement live-api mode with tiering, progressive title search, best-similarity selection
Verify against Phase 2 test doc_ids and side-effect-free

approaches_tried.approach: Use literal zotero_key field value as Zotero API item key path for fast path
approaches_tried.reason: index.json zotero_key is a citekey-style string (e.g. Burgess1982I), not a real 8-char Zotero item key; GET /items/<that>/children 404s

approaches_tried.approach: Take first search candidate with a PDF child attachment as the match
approaches_tried.reason: for pnueli_1977_temporal-logic-programs, first-with-PDF picked a different paper by Lamport (1980) with similar title words; correctly demoted to best-similarity selection, still surfaced as search-candidate for Phase 4 to reject on year mismatch

deviations.description: Fast path: if zotero_key is non-null, GET /api/users/0/items/<key>/children
deviations.reason: The literal zotero_key field values in index.json are Better-BibTeX-style citekeys, not real Zotero API item keys (confirmed empirically: direct lookup 404s). Implemented as: still search by title/author, but tier the result key-anchored (vs search-candidate) based on whether index.json pre-populated zotero_key, preserving the trust-level distinction the plan's tier scheme depends on.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: the literal zotero_key field in index.json is a citekey-style string, not a real Zotero API item key ... see plan Phase 2 task annotation)*

deviations.reason: Zotero's quick search requires all query tokens present; a full corpus title with a trailing slug-derived word not in the real bibliographic title (e.g. fine_2014's 'Intuitionistic' suffix) returns zero hits. Added progressive right-truncation (drop trailing words to a 2-word floor) before falling back to author-only search. This was required to correctly surface fine_2014's true Zotero candidate (S2VXD9JT) instead of a spurious low-similarity author-only match.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: added progressive title right-truncation ... see plan Phase 2 task annotation)*
